AI (Artificial Intelligence) is the ability of machines or computers to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning, problem-solving, and understanding language.

📖 Explanation  
- AI systems can learn from data and improve over time.  
- They can recognize patterns, make decisions, and even understand speech or images.  
- Examples include virtual assistants (like Siri), recommendation systems (like Netflix), and self-driving cars.  
- AI is used in many fields to automate tasks and help humans work more efficiently.
